description:
Create a 3D model of an angled sensor mount using FreeCAD's Part Design workbench. 

Goal: Create a base plate with an angled cylindrical mounting boss.

Specifications:
1. Base Plate: Create a rectangular base on the XY plane with dimensions 60 mm (Length) x 40 mm (Width) x 5 mm (Height/Pad).
2. Angled Plane: Create a 'Datum Plane' attached to the top face of the base plate. Rotate this plane 45 degrees around the Y-axis so it slopes upward.
3. Mounting Boss: On this new Datum Plane, create a sketch of a Circle (20 mm diameter) and Pad it 15 mm outwards.
4. Through Hole: Create a 10 mm diameter hole extending through the boss and base.

Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/sensor_mount.FCStd' and export the final body as an STL file to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/sensor_mount.stl'.
